gear.name: Millhaven Guard Sword
gear.description: A functional longsword issued to town militia.

gear.name: Minor Hearth-Water
gear.description: Water from the temple well at Millhaven, kept a night beside the altar fire in a stoppered clay flask. Ashkyr keeps the hearth, and the water remembers being kept.
gear.special: Drink it, or get it into somebody within reach, for 1 action: it restores 1d8 Hit Points, and gets somebody who is down back on their feet.

gear.name: Nail-Iron Spade
gear.description: A gravedigger's spade reforged around the old charm-nails pulled from the Whisperwood treeline. Heavier than it looks, and it wants to go downward.
gear.special: The first Strike each day against a creature that has been buried deals 1d6 additional damage.

gear.name: Charm of Iron Nails
gear.description: Four nails bound in waxed thread, of the kind somebody has been hammering into trunks at shoulder height all along the wood's edge. Nobody in Millhaven will say who.
gear.special: Activate when you fail a save against a shadow effect to reroll it with a +1 item bonus. The charm is spent.

gear.name: The Thrall's Nail
gear.description: Thralls come out of the Whisperwood with these in them, driven in at the base of the skull and long since grown over. Pulling one free is easy. Deciding to keep it is the part people regret.
gear.special: +1 item bonus to saves against effects that would control you, while you hold it. On a critical hit, the target cannot become concealed until the end of your next turn.

gear.name: Drover's Goad
gear.description: An ash staff shod with iron at one end and a bronze hook at the other, worn smooth by a lifetime of arguing with cattle. The bronze is a good deal older than the ash.
gear.special: +1 item bonus to Nature checks made to Command an Animal.

gear.name: A Map of the Millhaven Valley
gear.description: Drawn on the back of a feed merchant's bill in three colours of ink and corrected in a fourth: the town, the wood's edge and what lies past it, the farms to the north, and the Mere Road south to the old mill. Somebody has drawn a small careful cross in the middle of the Whisperwood, and then scratched it out.
gear.special: Carry it, and "map" shows the whole of the Millhaven Valley, every road through it and how long each one takes.

gear.name: Lesser Hearth-Water
gear.description: The same temple water, kept three nights instead of one, with a pinch of hearth-ash stirred in. It tastes of smoke and is warm all the way down.
gear.special: Drink it, or get it into somebody within reach, for 1 action: it restores 2d8+5 Hit Points, and gets somebody who is down back on their feet.

gear.name: Whisperwood Longbow
gear.description: Cut from a tree that grew inside the ring and cured for nine years. It is quiet in a way that has nothing to do with craftsmanship.
gear.special: Striking rune. Ignores the concealment granted by natural darkness.

gear.name: Handful of Hollow Ash
gear.description: What a thrall leaves when it finally stops. It does not scatter in wind, and it is cold in a way ash has no business being.
gear.special: Activate when a creature with the shadow trait would become incorporeal to prevent it until the end of your next turn. The ash is spent.

gear.name: Shadowbane Dagger
gear.description: Dwarven runes run along the fuller. It hums near darkness.
gear.special: Extra 1d4 damage vs. Shadow entities.

gear.name: Oilskin Brigandine
gear.description: Road armour: steel plates riveted inside a coat of oiled canvas that has been rained on across three kingdoms and has kept out every drop.
gear.special: +1 item bonus to Fortitude saves against cold and exposure.

gear.name: A Plan of Valorheim
gear.description: A copyist's fair copy of the Grand Library's survey of the capital: the palace and its plaza, the mine head, the gates of Thornhaven. The Crown's seal is printed in the corner. What is under the city is not on it, and the margin where it would go has been left very carefully blank.
gear.special: Carry it, and "map" shows the streets of Valorheim and every road out of them. Nothing below the streets is on it.

gear.name: Ravencrest Hide
gear.description: Farm leather, patched and re-patched, still smelling faintly of the byre. The previous owner's name is inked inside the collar and has been crossed through once.
gear.special: +1 item bonus to Survival checks made within a day's walk of Millhaven.

gear.name: Moderate Hearth-Water
gear.description: Kept a full week by the fire and blessed at every dawn of it. Brother Aldus seals these himself, in wax the colour of embers.
gear.special: Drink it, or get it into somebody within reach, for 1 action: it restores 3d8+10 Hit Points, and gets somebody who is down back on their feet.

gear.name: Lamp of the Last Shift
gear.description: A miner's lamp that was still burning when they brought it up, and has not needed oil since. The flame leans away from the mine face rather than toward the draught.
gear.special: Sheds light in a 30-foot radius. Creatures with the shadow trait take a -1 status penalty to attack rolls while within it, and the flame leans toward the nearest one.

gear.name: Tollkeeper's Hook
gear.description: A polearm with a hook for pulling riders out of the saddle and a spike for the ones who would not pay. The tollhouse it came from has stood empty since the road was closed.
gear.special: Striking rune. On a critical hit against a mounted or flying creature, it is knocked prone.

gear.name: Grave-Warden's Mail
gear.description: Mail worn by whoever in a parish is expected to stand between the living and whatever comes up. Millhaven has not appointed one in sixty years.
gear.special: Resilient rune. +1 item bonus to saves against effects that would make you grabbed or restrained by an undead creature.

gear.name: Thrall-Breaker
gear.description: A blacksmith's maul with the head re-cast around a broken seal-stone. Harrow's Forge made three and finished only this one.
gear.special: On a successful Strike against a creature raised by another's will, that creature is cut off from whoever raised it until the end of your next turn.

gear.name: The Branch That Grew Back
gear.description: The bowyers cut from the tree inside the ring every ninth year, and never twice from the same limb. This is the limb they took first, back again, and longer than it was.
gear.special: Striking rune. On a critical hit, roots hold the target in place until the end of your next turn, whether or not there is any soil.

gear.name: Mourner's Mail
gear.description: A fine chain shirt worn under mourning black by a professional mourner, back when that was a trade. It makes a sound like quiet weeping when you move, and after a day you stop hearing it.
gear.special: +1 item bonus to saves against effects that would make you frightened.

gear.name: The Avatar's Crown-Spike
gear.description: The Avatar wears a ring of these and is not wearing a crown. When it goes down one of them stays behind — always one, never the same one twice.
gear.special: Striking rune. Ignores the resistance an incorporeal creature has to physical damage. While it is drawn, you can see the shadow of anything that is keeping one hidden.

gear.name: Covenant Inquisitor's Blade
gear.description: Well balanced, well kept, and engraved along the ricasso with a line of scripture that the Covenant no longer reads the same way it used to.
gear.special: +1 item bonus to Deception checks made while openly carrying it among Covenant members.

gear.name: Palace Guard Cuirass
gear.description: Crown issue, crimson-lacquered, and newer than the man who was wearing it. The quartermaster's stamp inside is dated after his funeral.
gear.special: +1 item bonus to Society checks made inside the Palace District.

gear.name: Covenant Censer-Chain
gear.description: Acolytes swing these at the head of a procession, and the smoke is the point: it is what keeps a congregation from noticing what the singing is doing to them.
gear.special: +1 item bonus to Deception checks made among Covenant members. On a successful Strike, the target takes a -1 status penalty to Will saves until the end of your next turn.

gear.name: Bloodstone Pick
gear.description: A mining pick whose head has taken up the red grain from the rock it was used on. It is warm at the haft, always, and the warmth is going the wrong way.
gear.special: Greater striking rune. Deals 2d6 additional damage to objects and to crystalline creatures.

gear.name: The Confessor's Needle
gear.description: Long, fine, and kept in a velvet roll with eleven others. The Covenant does not call what it does with these torture, and it is technically correct: the needle does the asking.
gear.special: +2 item bonus to Intimidation checks. A creature critically hit by it answers the next question it is asked truthfully, though nothing makes it answer at length.

gear.name: Greater Hearth-Water
gear.description: Drawn from the old cistern under the temple floor, which is opened once in a generation, and kept a month by the fire. The flask stays warm in the coldest pack.
gear.special: Drink it, or get it into somebody within reach, for 1 action: it restores 6d8+20 Hit Points, and gets somebody who is down back on their feet.

gear.name: Vex's Ascension Rod
gear.description: Malachai Vex did not carry a weapon. He carried the thing he intended to become, and used it on whoever stood between him and that.
gear.special: Greater striking rune. Once per day you may trade places with a creature within 30 feet that you can see, each of you appearing where the other stood. The rod was built for this and does not care that you are the one holding it.

gear.name: The Ledger of the Fourth Name
gear.description: A burial register kept in two hands: the undertaker's, and a second that added a small mark beside four of the entries afterward. The fifth line is still blank.
gear.special: +2 item bonus to Occultism checks and to Lore checks concerning the undead. While carried, you know without checking whether a corpse you can see died of what the record says it did.

gear.name: The Monarch's Vestment
gear.description: Golden plate armor fit for a king. It emanates majesty.
gear.special: +2 item bonus to Diplomacy checks.

gear.name: The Seal-Breaker's Athame
gear.description: The knife the Covenant opens seals with. It is not sharp and does not need to be: the edge is an argument rather than a blade.
gear.special: +2 item bonus to Occultism checks made to identify or undo a seal. It deals no damage at all to an unwarded object, and double damage to a warded one.

gear.name: Seal-Warden's Regalia
gear.description: Vestments of an office that predates the monarchy and was quietly dissolved by it. The seals worked into the hem are the same shape as the ones the Covenant is trying to break, drawn the other way round.
gear.special: +2 item bonus to saves against effects with the shadow trait. Once per day, when reduced to 0 Hit Points by such an effect, you are instead reduced to 1.

gear.name: The Sundering Edge
gear.description: Forged for the last Seal-Warden and buried with her, on the reasoning that the thing it was made to cut was already dealt with.
gear.special: Treats a creature's resistance to physical damage as 5 lower. On a critical hit against a creature with the shadow trait, that creature cannot become incorporeal until the end of your next turn.

gear.name: The Vessel's Chain
gear.description: A length of fine chain taken from Thornhaven, still warm. It is what the Covenant uses to keep a Vessel in one shape while the shape is being made ready.
gear.special: Resistance 10 to void damage. While worn, effects that would possess or displace you are attempted against your Will DC twice and take the worse result — and the chain becomes one link shorter each time it saves you.

gear.name: Shadow Ripper
gear.description: A blade forged to sever the ties between reality and the void.
gear.special: Dispels shadow magic in a 15-foot radius on critical hit.

gear.name: Major Hearth-Water
gear.description: Hearth-water kept a whole winter beside a fire nobody let go out. There are never more than a handful in the valley, and the temple knows where every one of them is.
gear.special: Drink it, or get it into somebody within reach, for 1 action: it restores 8d8+30 Hit Points, and gets somebody who is down back on their feet.

gear.name: The Last Nail
gear.description: One charm-nail out of the Whisperwood treeline, grown to the length of a short sword and still bearing the hammer marks of whoever drove it in. It has been holding something shut for a long time, and it is tired.
gear.special: Major striking rune. A creature critically hit by it cannot leave the room it currently occupies until the end of your next turn.

gear.name: The Crown of the Quiet Kingdom
gear.description: Not the crown of Valorheim. The crown of what was here before Valorheim, recovered from beneath it, worn by people who understood entropy well enough to decide against it.
gear.special: +3 item bonus to Diplomacy and Intimidation checks. Once per day, you may close one seal that has been broken, anywhere you can see, and know afterward exactly what it cost you.

gear.name: Dagger
gear.description: A plain double-edged knife with a leather grip, balanced for throwing as well as for everything else.

gear.name: Shortsword
gear.description: A short, broad thrusting blade of the kind the Watch issues and nobody gives back.

gear.name: Rapier
gear.description: A long, narrow blade with a swept hilt: a duellist's weapon, and a capital fashion.

gear.name: Longsword
gear.description: A knight's sword, or a farmer's grandfather's: straight, plain, and heavier than it looks.

gear.name: Greatsword
gear.description: Five feet of steel that wants both hands and most of the room.

gear.name: Battle Axe
gear.description: A broad-bladed axe on a hickory haft, made for people, not wood.

gear.name: Greataxe
gear.description: A crescent head the width of a man's chest on a haft as long as a leg.

gear.name: Warhammer
gear.description: A square-headed hammer with a spike behind, for armour that will not be cut.

gear.name: Maul
gear.description: A sledge with ambitions. It does not so much hit as arrive.

gear.name: Spear
gear.description: An ash pole and a leaf-shaped head. Every farm in the valley has one behind the door.

gear.name: Glaive
gear.description: A long blade on a longer pole, for keeping something at arm's length and then some.

gear.name: Halberd
gear.description: Axe, spike and hook on one pole: the Crown guard's answer to everything.

gear.name: Mace
gear.description: A flanged iron head on a short haft. Priests like them; so do bailiffs.

gear.name: Morningstar
gear.description: A spiked ball on a stout handle, as subtle as it looks.

gear.name: Light Hammer
gear.description: A smith's hammer that has been told it is a weapon, and believed it.

gear.name: Bo Staff
gear.description: Six feet of seasoned oak, iron-shod at both ends.

gear.name: Scimitar
gear.description: A curved blade from somewhere south, made for cutting from horseback.

gear.name: Flail
gear.description: A spiked head on a chain on a handle. The chain is the point.

gear.name: Falchion
gear.description: A heavy, single-edged blade that widens toward the tip like a cleaver.

gear.name: Bastard Sword
gear.description: A sword long enough for two hands and light enough for one, if the one is strong.

gear.name: Kukri
gear.description: A forward-curved knife, heavy at the tip. It chops like a hatchet.

gear.name: Whip
gear.description: A drover's whip, plaited leather with a lead-weighted tail.

gear.name: Javelin
gear.description: A light throwing spear, sold in bundles to people who expect to miss.

gear.name: Shortbow
gear.description: A hunter's bow, short enough to draw in a hedge.

gear.name: Longbow
gear.description: A yew bow as tall as the archer, and a good deal more patient.

gear.name: Composite Shortbow
gear.description: Horn, wood and sinew glued in layers: a short bow that pulls like a long one, and lets a strong arm tell.

gear.name: Composite Longbow
gear.description: A recurved war bow of horn and sinew. The strong get more out of it.

gear.name: Crossbow
gear.description: A stirrup crossbow. Anyone can shoot one; the trick is the reloading.

gear.name: Heavy Crossbow
gear.description: A windlass crossbow for walls and gates, brought down to the road.

gear.name: Hand Crossbow
gear.description: A crossbow small enough to hold in one hand and hide in a sleeve.

gear.name: Watchman's Spear
gear.description: A Millhaven Watch spear, the haft burned with the tower-and-water mark and the head kept bright by somebody who cared.
gear.special: A potency rune: a +1 item bonus to attack rolls with it, and one damage die.

gear.name: Reedcutter Shortbow
gear.description: Strung by a fowler from the Mere and waxed against the damp. It has never once warped, which the fowler takes personally.
gear.special: A potency rune: a +1 item bonus to attack rolls with it, and one damage die.

gear.name: Fenward Axe
gear.description: An old Fenward family axe with a new edge and an older rune, still keen after three generations of being lent out.
gear.special: A potency rune: a +1 item bonus to attack rolls with it, and one damage die.

gear.name: Duellist's Rapier
gear.description: A capital rapier with a cup hilt and a crest filed off it. Whoever it belonged to left town owing Harrow money.
gear.special: Potency and striking runes: a +1 item bonus to attack rolls with it, and two damage dice.

gear.name: Tollgate Arbalest
gear.description: One of the heavy crossbows from the king's road tollgate, sold off when the gate shut, its windlass oiled and its sights true.
gear.special: Potency and striking runes: a +1 item bonus to attack rolls with it, and two damage dice.

gear.name: Bridgeguard Glaive
gear.description: Carried on the Valorheim bridges by guards who were never once called on to use it, until this year.
gear.special: Potency and striking runes: a +1 item bonus to attack rolls with it, and two damage dice.

gear.name: Greywood Longbow
gear.description: A war bow backed with grey horn, from the royal bowyers. The string hums a long time after the arrow has gone.
gear.special: Potency and striking runes: a +1 item bonus to attack rolls with it, and two damage dice.

gear.name: Archive Kukri
gear.description: Issued to the Grand Library's night porters, which tells you something about the night porters, or about the library.
gear.special: Potency and striking runes: a +1 item bonus to attack rolls with it, and two damage dice.

gear.name: Minebreaker Axe
gear.description: A greataxe forged from a mine-gate bar. The dwarves who made it say it remembers the weight of the mountain.
gear.special: Potency and striking runes: a +1 item bonus to attack rolls with it, and two damage dice.

gear.name: Knight-Captain's Sword
gear.description: A Crown officer's sword, plain where a courtier's would be gilded, and sharper for it.
gear.special: Potency and striking runes: a +2 item bonus to attack rolls with it, and two damage dice.

gear.name: Palace Halberd
gear.description: Black-lacquered and silver-chased, from the palace stair. The lacquer is for show; the edge is not.
gear.special: Potency and striking runes: a +2 item bonus to attack rolls with it, and two damage dice.

gear.name: Whisper Blade
gear.description: A short, matt-grey blade that makes no sound leaving the scabbard and very little going in.
gear.special: Potency and greater striking runes: a +2 item bonus to attack rolls with it, and three damage dice.

gear.name: Seal-Mason's Maul
gear.description: The maul the old seal-masons used to set boundary stones. Its head is the same stone as the seals.
gear.special: Potency and greater striking runes: a +2 item bonus to attack rolls with it, and three damage dice.

gear.name: Quiet Court Crossbow
gear.description: Taken from the Quiet Court's gate. Its bolts are stamped with names nobody in Valorheim remembers.
gear.special: Potency and greater striking runes: a +2 item bonus to attack rolls with it, and three damage dice.

gear.name: Riftwalker Scimitar
gear.description: Carried up out of the Rift by somebody who did not carry anything else up. The blade is cold in summer.
gear.special: Potency and greater striking runes: a +2 item bonus to attack rolls with it, and three damage dice.

gear.name: Cradle-Breaker
gear.description: A greatsword the Quiet Court's courtiers carry and never draw, until the Cradle is threatened. It is heavier than steel ought to be.
gear.special: Potency and greater striking runes: a +3 item bonus to attack rolls with it, and three damage dice.

gear.name: Last Light Longbow
gear.description: A longbow cut from the last tree to stand on the Causeway of Names. Its arrows burn faintly in the dark.
gear.special: Potency and greater striking runes: a +3 item bonus to attack rolls with it, and three damage dice.

gear.name: Unmaking-Ward Flail
gear.description: The hierophants' own flail, its chain links each stamped with a seal-sign, turned now against whatever wields the Unmaking.
gear.special: Potency and greater striking runes: a +3 item bonus to attack rolls with it, and three damage dice.

gear.name: Quietus
gear.description: The rapier of the last seal-breaker, so fine it bends in the wind and so sharp it does not need to be swung hard.
gear.special: Potency and major striking runes: a +3 item bonus to attack rolls with it, and four damage dice.

gear.name: Hammer of the First Seal
gear.description: The hammer that set the first seal in the valley, a thousand years before Millhaven. The Last Quiet King kept it to make sure nobody would set another.
gear.special: Potency and major striking runes: a +3 item bonus to attack rolls with it, and four damage dice.

gear.name: Lesser Alchemist's Fire
gear.description: A clay flask of something that catches the moment air reaches it and keeps burning on whatever it lands on.
gear.special: Thrown, for 1 action, at an enemy no further than near: 1d8 fire damage on a hit, double on a critical, and 1 splash damage even on a miss.

gear.name: Moderate Alchemist's Fire
gear.description: A clay flask of something that catches the moment air reaches it and keeps burning on whatever it lands on.
gear.special: Thrown, for 1 action, at an enemy no further than near: 2d8 fire damage on a hit, double on a critical, and 2 splash damage even on a miss, with a +1 item bonus to the attack roll.

gear.name: Greater Alchemist's Fire
gear.description: A clay flask of something that catches the moment air reaches it and keeps burning on whatever it lands on.
gear.special: Thrown, for 1 action, at an enemy no further than near: 3d8 fire damage on a hit, double on a critical, and 3 splash damage even on a miss, with a +2 item bonus to the attack roll.

gear.name: Major Alchemist's Fire
gear.description: A clay flask of something that catches the moment air reaches it and keeps burning on whatever it lands on.
gear.special: Thrown, for 1 action, at an enemy no further than near: 4d8 fire damage on a hit, double on a critical, and 4 splash damage even on a miss, with a +3 item bonus to the attack roll.

gear.name: Lesser Acid Flask
gear.description: A stoppered flask of green acid, wrapped in straw so it does not eat the pack on the way.
gear.special: Thrown, for 1 action, at an enemy no further than near: 1d6 acid damage on a hit, double on a critical, and 1 splash damage even on a miss.

gear.name: Moderate Acid Flask
gear.description: A stoppered flask of green acid, wrapped in straw so it does not eat the pack on the way.
gear.special: Thrown, for 1 action, at an enemy no further than near: 2d6 acid damage on a hit, double on a critical, and 2 splash damage even on a miss, with a +1 item bonus to the attack roll.

gear.name: Greater Acid Flask
gear.description: A stoppered flask of green acid, wrapped in straw so it does not eat the pack on the way.
gear.special: Thrown, for 1 action, at an enemy no further than near: 3d6 acid damage on a hit, double on a critical, and 3 splash damage even on a miss, with a +2 item bonus to the attack roll.

gear.name: Major Acid Flask
gear.description: A stoppered flask of green acid, wrapped in straw so it does not eat the pack on the way.
gear.special: Thrown, for 1 action, at an enemy no further than near: 4d6 acid damage on a hit, double on a critical, and 4 splash damage even on a miss, with a +3 item bonus to the attack roll.

gear.name: Lesser Frost Vial
gear.description: A thin glass vial, frosted on the outside, that bursts into a cloud of rime.
gear.special: Thrown, for 1 action, at an enemy no further than near: 1d6 cold damage on a hit, double on a critical, and 1 splash damage even on a miss.

gear.name: Moderate Frost Vial
gear.description: A thin glass vial, frosted on the outside, that bursts into a cloud of rime.
gear.special: Thrown, for 1 action, at an enemy no further than near: 2d6 cold damage on a hit, double on a critical, and 2 splash damage even on a miss, with a +1 item bonus to the attack roll.

gear.name: Greater Frost Vial
gear.description: A thin glass vial, frosted on the outside, that bursts into a cloud of rime.
gear.special: Thrown, for 1 action, at an enemy no further than near: 3d6 cold damage on a hit, double on a critical, and 3 splash damage even on a miss, with a +2 item bonus to the attack roll.

gear.name: Major Frost Vial
gear.description: A thin glass vial, frosted on the outside, that bursts into a cloud of rime.
gear.special: Thrown, for 1 action, at an enemy no further than near: 4d6 cold damage on a hit, double on a critical, and 4 splash damage even on a miss, with a +3 item bonus to the attack roll.

gear.name: Lesser Bottled Lightning
gear.description: A copper-capped bottle full of a storm, crackling faintly against the glass.
gear.special: Thrown, for 1 action, at an enemy no further than near: 1d6 electricity damage on a hit, double on a critical, and 1 splash damage even on a miss.

gear.name: Moderate Bottled Lightning
gear.description: A copper-capped bottle full of a storm, crackling faintly against the glass.
gear.special: Thrown, for 1 action, at an enemy no further than near: 2d6 electricity damage on a hit, double on a critical, and 2 splash damage even on a miss, with a +1 item bonus to the attack roll.

gear.name: Greater Bottled Lightning
gear.description: A copper-capped bottle full of a storm, crackling faintly against the glass.
gear.special: Thrown, for 1 action, at an enemy no further than near: 3d6 electricity damage on a hit, double on a critical, and 3 splash damage even on a miss, with a +2 item bonus to the attack roll.

gear.name: Major Bottled Lightning
gear.description: A copper-capped bottle full of a storm, crackling faintly against the glass.
gear.special: Thrown, for 1 action, at an enemy no further than near: 4d6 electricity damage on a hit, double on a critical, and 4 splash damage even on a miss, with a +3 item bonus to the attack roll.

gear.name: Lesser Thunderstone
gear.description: A stone the size of an egg that goes off like a thunderclap where it lands.
gear.special: Thrown, for 1 action, at an enemy no further than near: 1d4 sonic damage on a hit, double on a critical, and 1 splash damage even on a miss.

gear.name: Moderate Thunderstone
gear.description: A stone the size of an egg that goes off like a thunderclap where it lands.
gear.special: Thrown, for 1 action, at an enemy no further than near: 2d4 sonic damage on a hit, double on a critical, and 2 splash damage even on a miss, with a +1 item bonus to the attack roll.

gear.name: Greater Thunderstone
gear.description: A stone the size of an egg that goes off like a thunderclap where it lands.
gear.special: Thrown, for 1 action, at an enemy no further than near: 3d4 sonic damage on a hit, double on a critical, and 3 splash damage even on a miss, with a +2 item bonus to the attack roll.

gear.name: Major Thunderstone
gear.description: A stone the size of an egg that goes off like a thunderclap where it lands.
gear.special: Thrown, for 1 action, at an enemy no further than near: 4d4 sonic damage on a hit, double on a critical, and 4 splash damage even on a miss, with a +3 item bonus to the attack roll.

gear.name: Lesser Blight Bomb
gear.description: A fragile gourd of yellow spores that bursts into choking dust.
gear.special: Thrown, for 1 action, at an enemy no further than near: 1d6 poison damage on a hit, double on a critical, and 1 splash damage even on a miss.

gear.name: Moderate Blight Bomb
gear.description: A fragile gourd of yellow spores that bursts into choking dust.
gear.special: Thrown, for 1 action, at an enemy no further than near: 2d6 poison damage on a hit, double on a critical, and 2 splash damage even on a miss, with a +1 item bonus to the attack roll.

gear.name: Greater Blight Bomb
gear.description: A fragile gourd of yellow spores that bursts into choking dust.
gear.special: Thrown, for 1 action, at an enemy no further than near: 3d6 poison damage on a hit, double on a critical, and 3 splash damage even on a miss, with a +2 item bonus to the attack roll.

gear.description: The same blackened oak, bound in red iron, with a coal that never goes out set in the flame.

gear.special: Holds Heal (5th), Heal (7th). 8 charges a day, back after a night's rest: a spell costs as many as its rank, a cantrip none.

gear.name: Stormwarden's Staff
gear.description: A copper-shod staff of lightning-struck oak, carried by the wardens who keep the capital's roofs from burning in the summer storms.
